rules.name: FSSAI licence number not found
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 (licence number on the label); third-party seller guides report Blinkit holds listings without it on the primary pack. Verify on Blinkit Seller Hub.
rules.explanation: No 14-digit FSSAI licence number was found in the label text. Blinkit checks for it on the primary pack (not a sticker or insert), and listings without it are put on hold.
rules.advice: Print your FSSAI licence number on the primary pack, next to the FSSAI logo.

rules.name: "Natural" claim on a multi-ingredient food
rules.citation: FSS (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018 (use of "natural"); third-party seller guides report Blinkit checks this at listing review. Verify on Blinkit Seller Hub.
rules.explanation: "Natural" is reserved for single foods with nothing added. A product made from several ingredients may only say "made from natural ingredients".
rules.advice: Change it to "made from natural ingredients", or remove the word.
